messages.content: You are a precise information extraction system. You only output valid JSON.

Extract entities and events from the document below.

Entity types: Person, Organization, Location, Building, Product, Art, Other

Event types and their argument roles:
- Attack: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Consequence
- Military_operation: roles = Agent, Patient, Location
- Conquering: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Name
- Killing: roles = Killer, Victim, Location, Cause, Instrument
- Death: roles = Agent, Cause, Location, Instrument
- Bodily_harm: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Cause
- Catastrophe: roles = Patient, Location, Loss, Content
- Destroying: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Damaging: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Statement: roles = Speaker, Message, Location, Details
- Change_of_leadership: roles = New_leader, Old_leader, Location, Selector, New_Occupation, Old_Occupation
- Arriving: roles = Agent, Location

Rules:
1. Copy every entity mention, trigger and argument exactly as it appears in the document.
2. List every entity mention (including repeated mentions of the same entity).
3. Create one event entry for every trigger occurrence of the event types above. Ignore other kinds of events.
4. Arguments may appear anywhere in the document, not only in the trigger's sentence. Omit roles with no argument.

Return a JSON object in exactly this format:
{
  "entities": [
    {
      "text": "<entity mention copied from the text>",
      "type": "<entity type>"
    }
  ],
  "events": [
    {
      "trigger": "<word or short phrase in the text that signals the event>",
      "type": "<event type>",
      "arguments": {
        "<role>": [
          "<argument span copied from the text>"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

Document:
The Battle of Legnano was fought between the imperial army of Frederick Barbarossa and the troops of the Lombard League on May 29 , 1176 near the town of Legnano , in present-day Lombardy , in Italy . although the presence of the enemy nearby was already known to both sides , they suddenly met without having time to plan any strategy . The battle was crucial in the long war waged by the Holy Roman Empire to attempt to assert its power over the municipalities of Northern Italy , which decided to put aside their mutual rivalries by allying themselves in a military union symbolically led by Pope Alexander III , the Lombard League . The battle ended the fifth and last descent in Italy of Emperor Frederick Barbarossa , which after the defeat tried to resolve the Italian question by attempting the diplomatic approach . This resulted a few years later in the Peace of Constance ( June 25 , 1183 ) , with which the Emperor recognized the Lombard League giving administrative , political and judicial concessions to the municipalities and officially putting an end to his attempt to dominate Northern Italy . The battle refers to the `` Il Canto degli Italiani '' by Goffredo Mameli and Michele Novaro , which reads : « [ ... ] From the Alps to Sicily , Legnano is everywhere [ ... ] » in memory of the victory of Italian populations over foreign ones . Thanks to this battle , Legnano is the only city , besides Rome , to be mentioned in the Italian national anthem . In Legnano , to commemorate the battle , the Palio di Legnano takes place annually from 1935 , on the last sunday of May . In the institutional sphere , the date of May 29 was chosen as the regional holiday of Lombardy .
